title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 223 ]

blocks.text: Some people believe that if they have much money, they will be happy. They believe that if they are wealthy, they will be able to do everything they want, and so they will be happy. On the other hand, some people value their religion, or their intelligence, or their health ; these make them happy. For me , happiness is closely tied to my family. I am happy if my wife and children live in harmony. When all members of my family share good and sad times, and communicate with each other, I am happy.

readingSentences.english: Some people believe that if they have much money, they will be happy.
readingSentences.korean: 어떤 사람들은 많은 돈을 가지면 행복할 거라고 믿는다.

readingSentences.english: They believe that if they are wealthy, they will be able to do everything they want, and so they will be happy.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 부유하면 하고 싶은 모든 일을 할 수 있고, 그래서 행복할 거라고 믿는다.

readingSentences.english: On the other hand, some people value their religion, or their intelligence, or their health ; these make them happy.
readingSentences.korean: 반면에 어떤 사람들은 그들의 종교나 지식, 건강에 가치를 두고, 이러한 것들은 그들을 행복하게 만든다.

readingSentences.english: For me , happiness is closely tied to my family.
readingSentences.korean: 나의 경우 행복이란 나의 가족과 밀접하게 연결되어 있다.

readingSentences.english: I am happy if my wife and children live in harmony.
readingSentences.korean: 나의 부인과 아이들이 조화를 이루고 산다면 난 행복하다.

readingSentences.english: When all members of my family share good and sad times, and communicate with each other, I am happy.
readingSentences.korean: 내 가족 구성원 모두가 좋은 시간과 슬픈 시간을 함께 나누고 서로 의사 소통을 할 때 난 행복하다.
